silicon_melting_1_subtask_structure_retr.name: Silicon Structure Retrieval for Melting - Level 1
silicon_melting_1_subtask_structure_retr.description: Retrieve structure of Silicon and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

silicon_melting_1_subtask_potential_file.name: Silicon Potential File for Melting - Level 1
silicon_melting_1_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential file for Silicon for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting.name: Silicon NPT Melting - Level 1
silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Silicon structure file and Stillinger–Weber potential file, simulate melting under NPT with the given simulation parameters. simulate melting under NPT with the given simulation parameters. Return the path to the trajectory file and the final density of the melt in g/cm^3.

silicon_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity.name: Silicon Diffusivity Calculation - Level 1
silicon_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity.description: Given the path to the trajectory file from the melting simulation, compute the mean squared displacement (MSD) of Si atoms over the trajectory. Identify the melting point as the first frame where the MSD shows a sudden jump. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state using the MSD after the detected melting point, and report the average value in m²/s.
